title: Hydrogen Storage in Single-Walled Carbon Nanotubes at Room Temperature
material_description: 1 | as-synthesized SWNTs (sample 1 in text; 'Sample 1#' in Fig. 3 legend), ~500 mg from one batch; semi-continuous hydrogen arc discharge (rotatable graphite-powder anode, Ni/Co/Fe catalysts 3/0.75/0.75 at.%, FeS 1 at.% growth promoter, H2 buffer gas); mean tube diameter 1.85 +/- 0.05 nm (HRTEM; Raman RBM 121 and 138 cm-1 give 1.85 and 1.62 nm); bundles ~20 nm; catalyst residue ~40 wt% by TGA in the as-prepared product
notes: Pressure printed as '100 to 120 atm' of H2 (Table 1 caption), 'about 10 to 12 MPa' (text p. 1128) and 'about 10 megapascal' (abstract, for the 4.2 wt% sample); stored as 10 MPa = 100 bar, the lower end and the value the abstract attaches to the reported capacity; equilibrium pressure itself not stated. Equilibrium at 298 K reached after typically 6 hours. Capacity 'based on the pressure changes' (volumetric pressure-drop method). Uncertainty printed as 'an error of <0.38 weight %' (Table 1 caption), stored as 0.38. Sample mass = Table 1 initial mass 480.1 mg; final mass after venting 482.6 mg; residual H2 storage 21.2% of total capacity (Table 1, not a row). Residual metal 40 wt%: printed 'the content of the catalyst residue in our products was ~40 weight %' (TGA, as-prepared products, p. 1128). Fig. 3 shows this sample's uptake against time (kinetics, not digitized). No surface area or pore volume is reported anywhere in the paper. Degassing: sample cell heated to 423 K (stored as 149.85 C) and vacuum-degassed for 'several hours' (duration not a number, not stored); vacuum printed as 'about 1.3 Pa torr in the control experiment' (unit ambiguous and a control run, not stored). Apparatus described with schematic and component list (Fig. 2: copper sample cell, stainless-steel H2 reservoir, H2 source, vacuum system, high-pressure gauge, bellows valves) but not named; coded instrument_identified true as an in-house apparatus described in the paper. System volume 'measured to be 45.10 ml' with no method stated, so calibration_described false. Paper names no basis (excess/absolute/total) and defines no wt% convention. Material class SWCNT; residual Ni, Co, Fe catalyst recorded as residual metal, not as a composite phase.
